SELECT p.id AS jobId, p.title, p.company_id AS companyId, hc.name AS companyName, p.city_code AS cityCode, p.city_name AS cityName, p.industry_code AS industryCode, pf.job_type AS jobType, p.salary_min_amount AS salaryMinAmount, p.salary_max_amount AS salaryMaxAmount, p.is_salary_negotiable AS salaryNegotiable, pf.core_skills AS skillTagsRaw, p.status, p.total_hc AS totalHc, (p.total_hc - p.reserved_hc - p.confirmed_hc) AS availableHc, p.published_at AS publishedAt FROM job_post p LEFT JOIN job_profile pf ON pf.job_id = p.id LEFT JOIN hr_company hc ON hc.id = p.company_id
